description.value: Motel Tyrol is a family-owned motel in the Village of Radium Hot Springs, situated in the Columbia Valley between the Rocky and Purcell Mountains along Highway 93/the Banff-Windermere Parkway. The property is 2 km from the famous natural mineral hot springs pool and offers mountain views from every room, plus its own year-round swim spa and seasonal heated outdoor pool and hot tub. Guests receive a complimentary breakfast voucher to Screamers Cafe, 800 m away, and the Juniper Trail trailhead is a five-minute walk from the motel.

address.value: 5016 Highway 93, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0
